claim: Morpho activates a non-zero protocol fee routing borrower interest to the Morpho DAO or MORPHO holders, live on mainnet, before 2027-03-31
resolution_criteria: TRUE if a Morpho governance vote passes AND a non-zero protocol fee is live on at least one mainnet Morpho market before 2027-03-31, evidenced by an on-chain parameter change plus Morpho's own governance forum or documentation. reasoning: Morpho has the best integration lock-in in DeFi lending -- Coinbase consumer lending runs on it, outstanding loans hit an all-time-high 5B USD (Messari, 2026-09-01), deposits 14B, and Coinbase BTC-backed loans alone have facilitated over 1.25B. The fee switch exists in-contract, capped at 25% of borrower interest, and has never been flipped across roughly 257M USD of cumulative protocol fees. The reason is structural, not procedural: flipping it compresses depositor yield and unwinds the deposit base that justifies the valuation. The Uniswap natural experiment is the base rate -- UNIfication passed 2025-12-25, 100M UNI (~596M USD) was burned, and UNI made a cycle low of 2.90 two months later -- so the incentive to flip is weaker than the market assumes.

Rewards funded from the DAO treasury or from token emissions do NOT count -- the revenue must originate in Safe Pro subscriptions, protocol fees, or Safenet transaction fees.

Safe crossed 10M USD ARR in 2025, five times the 2M at end-2024, but that revenue accrues to the foundation and company, not to holders, so SAFE is a governance placebo today. The first live economic function arrived with Safenet Beta (six genesis validators staking at least 3.5M SAFE each) and SEP-55 explicitly defers fee-based rewards to a later phase. The call is whether that deferred phase actually lands. Base rate for DAO fee switches is poor and this one has been pending for years; the 2027-06-30 boundary is a calendar date, not a catalyst, because SafeDAO has published no dated timetable for the SEP-55 fee phase -- stated explicitly per EP-000b rather than pretending an anchor exists.
kill_criteria: SafeDAO explicitly rejects fee-based rewards, or Safe Labs moves monetisation into an equity entity that structurally excludes the token

claim: GEODNET annualised revenue is reported at 12.0 million USD or more at any point before 2027-03-31
resolution_criteria: TRUE if GEODNET's own reporting, DePIN Pulse, or Messari state GEODNET annualised revenue or ARR at or equal to 12.0 million USD or more at any point before 2027-03-31. Cumulative-to-date revenue does NOT count; the figure must be an annualised or trailing-twelve-month rate.
reasoning: GEODNET is the only network in the DePIN sector that passes both tests at once: a physical moat that cannot be forked (20,000-22,557 deployed RTK/GNSS base stations across 150+ countries, where centimetre correction accuracy is a function of baseline distance under ~30km, so a competitor must physically site and maintain hardware on other people's rooftops) and external customers paying real money (agriculture, surveying, robotics, autonomy). Revenue went 7.3M ARR in April 2026 to 8.19M in July 2026, number one on the DePIN Pulse leaderboard, roughly 200k USD/week and tripled since mid-2025. 80% of fiat data-service revenue buys back and burns GEOD; rewards halved 2026-06-30 and the network declared itself net-deflationary on 2026-08-01, meaning emissions-to-external-revenue is now below 1.0x -- the only name in the cluster where that is true. Reaching 12.0M requires ~47% growth over eight months against a recent run rate nearer 12% per quarter, which extrapolates to roughly 10.9M -- so this is deliberately set above the trend line. Sector context that should temper any enthusiasm: all of DePIN runs ~82M annualised revenue against ~6.95B of market cap, about 85x sales.
kill_criteria: Burn rate falls back below emissions, or a GNSS incumbent (Trimble, Hexagon, Topcon) bundles free RTK corrections with equipment
sources: DePIN Pulse revenue leaderboard April and July 2026 via CryptoDep/KuCoin mirrors; geodnet.com/geod station count; depinscan.io; cryptobriefing.com 2026-06-23 Coinbase listing

claim: Maple Finance reports assets under management of 6.0 billion USD or more before 2027-03-31
resolution_criteria: TRUE if Maple's official reporting (maple.finance insights or dashboard), Messari, or DefiLlama state Maple AUM at or above 6.0 billion USD at any point before 2027-03-31.
reasoning: Maple holds roughly 93% of the on-chain private-credit market with AUM of 4.6-4.8B at H1 2026, up 81% year over year, loans outstanding 1.9B (+123%), and 7.4B of year-to-date originations. The moat is contractual rather than technical: Robinhood selected Maple to power a yield-bearing stablecoin product and Kraken signed a warehouse facility financed through a bankruptcy-remote SPV in June 2026 -- a competitor can fork the contracts but not the signed facility or the legal structure. Accrual became real in August 2026 via MIP-021: 10% of monthly revenue to buybacks below 1.5M/month, scaling to 30% above 2M, on 13.7M of YTD revenue -- though only ~1.4M of buybacks have actually executed since September 2025, so the mechanism is new and small. Reaching 6.0B needs ~30% growth from 4.6B while credit typically contracts in a bear market, which is why this sits near a coin flip rather than tracking the 81% trailing growth rate.
kill_criteria: A borrower default forces SPV enforcement and impairs the book, or Robinhood/Kraken insource the function

claim: An equal-weighted basket of GEOD, SYRUP, JTO and PYTH outperforms an equal-weighted basket of MORPHO, ONDO, SAFE and CFG on total return from 2026-09-19 to 2027-03-31
resolution_criteria: Measure each token's USD price on 2026-09-19 and on 2027-03-31 using the CoinDesk ccix composite where available, otherwise CoinGecko closing price. Equal-weight the four names in each basket, compute simple total return per basket ignoring staking yield, and compare. TRUE if the accrual basket's return exceeds the governance-only basket's. If any constituent is delisted or migrates to a new token, use the migration-adjusted price; if that is impossible, drop the name and equal-weight the remainder.
reasoning: This is the central falsifiable claim of the own-the-routing-mechanism thesis, stated so it can be graded rather than argued. The accrual basket routes real cash to tokens today: GEODNET burns 80% of external revenue and went net-deflationary 2026-08-01 at ~8.19M ARR on a ~124M cap; Maple's MIP-021 sends 10-30% of revenue to buybacks on 13.7M YTD revenue at ~258M cap; Jito takes 3% of all Solana tips via TipRouter with 100% of Block Engine and BAM fees to the DAO at ~246M cap; Pyth runs 7.49M ARR growing 22% month-over-month with a reserve buying back at ~483M cap. The governance-only basket has larger or equally real moats and routes nothing: Morpho (5B loans, Coinbase integration, fee switch never flipped), Ondo (3.43B AUM, FINRA and SEC licences, zero accrual), Safe (35.25B secured, ARR to the foundation), Centrifuge (S&P AA+f rated JTRSY at ~882M, 0 USD to holders). P is only 0.55 because the mechanism is a mechanism, not a guarantee: over six months, crypto small-cap returns are dominated by liquidity and beta, and three of the four accrual names are more illiquid than their counterparts, which cuts both ways. Ondo also carries the largest unlock overhang in either basket, which biases the comparison in my favour for reasons unrelated to accrual -- noted as a confound rather than claimed as edge.
kill_criteria: Accrual basket underperforms over two consecutive quarters, or GEODNET burn falls below emissions, or Maple's buyback lapses two consecutive months
sources: All constituent prices from CoinDesk ccix ticks fetched 2026-09-19 13:48-13:56 UTC; GEOD price secondary (not in ccix); revenue and mechanism figures per cluster research 2026-09-19
